run_metadata.S1_S2_method: One common baseline route plan constructed by fixed polar-angle order and constrained-first greedy insertion under daytime policy feasibility; no GA iterations or 2-opt. Same center assignment, vehicle type, and visit sequence evaluated under unrestricted and restricted matrices.
run_metadata.S3_method: GA with candidate-center bit chromosome and store permutation; S2 baseline permutation injected as an elite individual; directed 2-opt applied after GA; all 16 candidate-center bitsets conditionally decoded and each receives directed 2-opt before comparison.
run_metadata.fleet_constraint: Each vehicle can perform at most one route per day; route count by vehicle type cannot exceed the assumed available fleet count.
run_metadata.policy_matrix_note: The fuel_day and nev_eligible matrices are approximations based on the current road-network restriction processing, not authoritative legal GIS boundaries.
run_metadata.demand_note: Daily store demands are simulated inputs totaling 144.447 t/day; not enterprise transaction records.
run_metadata.vehicle_data_note: Fleet counts are explicit case-study assumptions, not observed enterprise fleet inventory.
run_metadata.global_optimality: All S3 results are heuristic best-found feasible solutions, not proofs of global optimality.
